rule: A report's county is the county whose outline holds its point, else the county its own record names; a water record's counties are those its box, padded by the name-match distance, reaches.

source.name: U.S. Census Bureau TIGERweb, State_County layer 1

time_zone.rule: Idaho north of the main channel of the Salmon River is in the Pacific zone (49 CFR 71.9(a) and (d)): the nine counties listed wholly, and Idaho County north of the river (its pacific_part); a municipality on the line keeps Mountain time; the rest of the state is Mountain.
